THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
WINTER PASSAGE
025
30 / Indigo Ridge
A standing portrait in front of a mossy stone wall: long
dark hair with wispy bangs, rosy cheeks, a navy indigo-dyed wrap
jacket with a red-and-white embroidered collar, a cream waist
sash with blue cords, a pleated dark skirt with bright blue and
orange woven hem bands and a velvet choker.
31 / Whiteout
An extreme close-up in a blizzard: a black textured knit
bucket hat and scarf covered in fresh snow, wind-blown strands
of hair, flushed cold-reddened cheeks, snow streaking across the
frame in motion blur and a cold blue color cast.
